items.question: How did Crystal Dangerfield play as a WNBA rookie?
items.answer: In 2020 with the Minnesota Lynx, Crystal Dangerfield averaged 16.2 points, 2.0 rebounds and 3.6 assists in 21 games and won WNBA Rookie of the Year. Full Court Buckets also has regular-season lines for her through 2024 with Minnesota, Indiana, New York, Dallas, Atlanta and Los Angeles.

items.question: Which WNBA teams has Crystal Dangerfield played for?
items.answer: Crystal Dangerfield has played for the Minnesota Lynx, New York Liberty, Indiana Fever, Dallas Wings, Los Angeles Sparks and Atlanta Dream.
